question: limits[].kind has no concurrent-connection or device-count kind. Six records file the stated count under request-rate (Trust.Zone, Obscura, VPN.ac, ZoogVPN) or name it only in limits_note (Cryptostorm, NymVPN, Mysterium VPN). Should a concurrent-connections kind be added?
why: Every VPN offer states a device or session ceiling and none of the seven kinds names it.
